answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, turning the network into a costly ivory tower where influence scales with investment rather than node count. An attacker aiming to dominate the future horizon of the ledger must control the majority of staked assets, making the creation of a fake-identity sonnet of thousands of bot nodes economically irrational and computationally futile against the sheer weight of verified financial risk.
